findings.message: #bg-music has data-volume="0.32" (-9.9 dB) and a GSAP tween on `volume`. Tween values are absolute: they REPLACE this gain rather than scale it, so wherever the tween names a value the clip plays at that value, not at -9.9 dB.
findings.fixHint: Write the tween's targets in the same absolute gain (e.g. `volume: 1.95`, not `volume: 1`), or reset data-volume to 1 and let the tween carry the level on its own.

findings.message: GSAP animation sets visibility on a clip element. Selector "#scene1" resolves to element <div id="scene1" class="clip">. The framework manages clip visibility, and autoAlpha writes visibility as well as opacity. Do not animate these properties on clip elements.
findings.fixHint: Remove the visibility/display/autoAlpha tween, or move the content into a child <div> and target that instead.

findings.message: This HTML composition file has 350 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split coherent scenes or layers into separate .html files under compositions/, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.

findings.message: <div id="scene1"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div id="scene1Card">. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="scene1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
